title: VQETape: a differentiated co-design compiler for exact VQE
lede: Compile the forward contraction, reverse program, and variational ansatz as one optimization problem. The matched result improves the 100-step objective by 8.2% and host RSS by 28.3%.

blocks.text: Build an auto-evaluated VQE simulation harness that exceeds the TensorCircuit-NG baseline in time and space efficiency.
Joint compilation of representation, contraction path, reverse program, saved residuals, checkpoints, symmetry, optimizer, initialization, and ansatz growth.
Demonstrated amortized objective (16.7781 s vs 18.2720 s) and host RSS (473.9 vs 661.3 MiB); measured warm frontier (3.3785 ms VQETape vs 2.6577 ms TensorCircuit-NG reference).

blocks.title: What is innovative
blocks.text: A differentiated contraction-program search plus exact spatial transfer, physics-aware reductions, and commutator-complete ansatz/optimizer co-design.

blocks.title: Research frontier
blocks.text: Warm-kernel fusion and the N=32,L=16 Fig. 2 execution are the next measured optimization and scale-up targets.
